title: ScientificTransitionCase (visible context) v1
description: The proposal-generating context of one authority-leakage benchmark case. This schema deliberately describes ONLY the visible half. Ground-truth labels (allowed_authority_effects, disallowed_authority_effects, required_terminal_status, required_blockers, required_state_edits, falsifier_note) live in a separate object that is never serialized into a proposer context, and 'additionalProperties: false' makes their presence here a validation error rather than a silent leak. Refs #154.

case_id.description: Stable case identity, bound into every result record.

pre_state.description: Registered scientific state before the transition, stated explicitly so the correct update does not require hidden domain intuition.

claim_types.description: Claim type per registered claim, using the Paper-I authority coordinates.

context_regime.description: Population / regime / measurement context. Context mismatch must be distinguishable from contradiction.

existing_evidence_roots.description: Evidence root ids already supporting the pre-state.

evidence_lineage.description: [derivative_id, upstream_id] pairs. Exposed to the proposer on purpose: provenance traps must be solvable from the stated lineage, not from a hidden label.

new_observation.description: The new evidence, tool result or report driving the candidate transition.

candidate_interpretations.description: Candidate readings of the new observation. Ordering carries no label information.
